## Cyberdeck.addConnection() method

Connects the indicated sockets between two mods.

If one of the mods is already charged, or if one of the connection points is the deck I/O panel, the other mod will become charged too.

**Signature:**

```typescript
addConnection(modId1: string, modId2: string, socketIndex: number): void;
```

## Remarks

RAM cost: 0.5 GB

Both mods need a socket on socketIndex in order to be able to connect.

Connections cannot overlap. For example, if there is a connection on index 0 from the mod in slot \#1 and the mod in slot \#3, no connections on index 0 can be made to a mod on slot 2, because the wire from slot 1 to 3 covers it. This can generally be resolved by re-ordering the installed mods.
